This action racing game machine allows communication-linked Versus Race game play when two to four units are connected. In the game, a player operates the kart driven by a game character and participates in a race. A player uses a pre-selected item to obstruct rivals in order to win the race. When a player wins a game, he/she gets a new item. The ultimate purpose of the game is to collect many useful items by winning races and continue winning by using collected items.
General description of the game « About game modes
+   Versus Race mode:   In this mode, the player competes with other players in a
communication-linked game. Up to four players can play in this mode. A winning player obtains an item.
+   Grand Prix mode:   This is a single-player mode. The player competes in each
of the six Cup races in order. Each time the player wins, he/ she obtains an item.
+   Time Attack mode:   This is a single-player mode. The player races against time
on a course with no rival karts.

« Versus Race mode + When aplayer inserts the required number of coins, the screen displays a message “Please wait!” At this point, the player’s entry in a Versus Race is registered. The other communicating units display “Waiting for entry!” and wait for players to join. When the Versus Race game is entered by one or more players, the game starts in the Versus Race mode. + When all participating players select their characters, the namcam2 (camera) captures the facial images of players and displays them on their respective screens. + After images are captured, the machine units display the “Select Stage” screen. After all players enter their choices, a stage is decided by a majority vote. (If the number of votes is the same between two stages, the easier stage is selected.)
